item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_bone_1.desc: A bone shard, held until the end.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_bone_2.desc: A small lamp with no light. It lay beside the grave marked "the seventh time".
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_bone_3.desc: A scrap wedged under a stone. "Tell the one waiting above I'm sorry."
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_salt_1.desc: A salt-crusted fragment. Its face was turned upward.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_salt_2.desc: A name tag bearing your own name. Only the date is different.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_salt_3.desc: Shells left by someone later. Three, laid in a row.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_storm_1.desc: A scorched cloak cord. Traces of fingers counting beats remain.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_storm_2.desc: A copper ring left when the lightning melted the tag.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_storm_3.desc: "Wake me when the next me arrives." When it rings, something far off seems to answer.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_ash_1.desc: A glove that left finger marks in the ash. It kept searching for a light to the end.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_ash_2.desc: The white tag of someone who came before writing a name.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic_ash_3.desc: A stone chip carved with a heart from the back of a grave. It almost seems to beat.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic.set_hint: Works while carried: two, four or six different belongings.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic.bonus.2: Night sight. In the abyss you see past the light.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic.bonus.4: Footsteps warn. A bell sounds underfoot when an abyss foe comes near.
item.skyabyss.abyss_relic.bonus.6: Light step. In the abyss you jump a little higher.
message.skyabyss.abyss.relic.all: All twelve graves are mourned. Every belonging was left facing the same night sky. Each one points at something round and broken.
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_all.title: Belongings of Those Before (Twelve)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_all.body:
Twelve graves of those before, mourned across the four layers of the abyss.

Every belonging was left facing the same night sky.

In the sky there was something round and broken. No one wrote down what it was.

"When that is full, we can go back up."

Only the one who forgot to write a name left those words.
